title: 第792章 灵机稻第791章 坐骑纷呈
slug: 青铜古舟第802章你惹上事了
content_zh:
果不其然，三人跨入院门，便见院子里的石桌旁，沈雪正蹲在地上，手里拿着一根狗尾巴草，逗弄着丫丫。
丫丫笑得前仰后合，小手抓着沈雪的衣袖不放，嘴里咿咿呀呀地喊着“姐姐”。
杨婶的儿媳妇站在一旁，笑眯眯地看着，不时伸手扶一下笑得快要摔倒的丫丫。
小六子的媳妇也在，正端着茶壶往石桌上放，见沈算等人回来，连忙行礼。
“算哥，源哥，小六。”沈雪抬起头，欢快地打招呼。
她今日穿了一身鹅黄色的衣裙，发间簪了一支白玉簪，衬得整个人明艳活泼，有种长不大的感觉。
“沈小姐好。”钟源和小六热切地回应。
沈算微笑地点点头，目光扫了一圈院子，没看到沈翊，便问道：“啥时候来的？你哥呢？”
“没多久。”沈雪站起身，拍了拍裙摆上的草屑，朝后院努了努嘴，“我哥和虎子去后院钓鱼了。”
“虎子说后院的池塘里有大鱼，我哥不信，两人打赌呢。”
“丫丫说要去捞鱼，她娘不让，正在这儿跟我闹呢。”
“钓鱼？”钟源嘴角一抽，把手中的鱼竿往小六手里一塞，“我去看看。”说完，大步流星往后院走。
“源哥，等等俺！”小六子也跟了上去。
院子里顿时少了两条人影，只剩沈算、沈雪，以及几个女眷和孩子。
沈算走到石桌旁坐下，小六媳妇连忙倒了一杯茶端过来。
他接过，抿了一口，是今年的新茶，入口清香，回味甘甜。
“算哥，你这院子真好。”沈雪坐到他对面，双手托腮，环顾四周，“清静，雅致，还有烟火气。”
“不像落叶峰，那里院子景色虽好，但住着总觉冷清。”
“你要是喜欢，随时来住。”沈算随口道。
“那我可当真了。”沈雪眼睛一亮，笑得眉眼弯弯。

正说着，后院忽然传来沈翊的喊声：“上钩了！上钩了！好大一条！”
紧接着是钟源的声音：“别拽别拽！线要断了！”
然后是虎子的惊呼：“哇——好大的鱼！”
紧接着就是一阵噼里啪啦的水花声，夹杂着几个人手忙脚乱的吆喝。
秋风送爽，稻浪千重。
沈算三人骑着烈焰马，沿着河道漫无目的地溜达。
河道蜿蜒如带，两岸是成片的青稻，稻穗低垂，随风轻舞，掀起一层层绿色的波浪，满目生机。
阳光洒在稻叶上，泛着细碎的金光，空气中弥漫着稻花的清香，混着泥土的气息，沁人心脾。
沈算拉紧缰绳，放慢了速度，目光落在那些沉甸甸的稻穗上。
他来到这个世界这么久，还是头一回看到稻田。
前世家乡的稻田也是这样，一望无际，风吹稻浪，美不胜收。
“少爷，这是灵机稻。”小六指着成片的水稻，介绍道，语气中带着几分得意，“是近几年培育出来的新品种，甚是香糯可口，内蕴一丝灵机，食之可滋养气血。端是好东西！”
“主族花费了数百年才培育成功，这几年才开始推广种植。”
content_en:
Sure enough, when the three of them stepped into the courtyard, they saw Shen Xue squatting on the ground beside the stone table in the courtyard, holding a piece of dogtail grass in her hand, teasing Yaya.
Yaya laughed so hard that she held onto Shen Xue's sleeves with her little hands and called "Sister" babblingly.
Aunt Yang's daughter-in-law stood aside, watching with a smile, and occasionally reaching out to help Yaya, who was about to fall over from laughing.
Xiao Liuzi's wife was also there, carrying a teapot and placing it on the stone table. Seeing Shen Suan and others coming back, she quickly saluted.
"Brother Suan, Brother Yuan, Xiaoliu." Shen Xue raised her head and greeted cheerfully.
She wore a goose-yellow dress today, with a white jade hairpin in her hair, which made her whole body bright and lively, giving her the feeling of not growing up.
"Hello, Miss Shen." Zhong Yuan and Xiao Liu responded eagerly.
Shen Suan smiled and nodded. He glanced around the yard. When he didn't see Shen Yi, he asked, "When did you come? Where is your brother?"
"It didn't take long." Shen Xue stood up, patted the grass clippings on her skirt, and pursed her lips toward the backyard, "My brother and Huzi went fishing in the backyard."
"Huzi said there was a big fish in the pond in the backyard, but my brother didn't believe it. The two of them were making a bet."
"Yaya said she wanted to go fishing, but her mother wouldn't let her go. She was making trouble with me here."
"Fishing?" Zhong Yuan twitched the corner of his mouth and put the fishing rod in Xiao Liu's hand. "I'll go take a look." After saying that, he strode towards the backyard.
"Brother Yuan, wait for me!" Xiao Liuzi also followed.
Two figures suddenly disappeared from the yard, leaving only Shen Suan, Shen Xue, and a few female family members and children.
Shen Suan walked to the stone table and sat down. Xiao Liu's wife quickly poured a cup of tea and brought it over.
He took it and took a sip. It was this year's new tea. It had a refreshing fragrance and a sweet aftertaste.
"Brother, your yard is really nice." Shen Xue sat opposite him, resting her chin on her hands, looking around, "It's quiet, elegant, and full of fireworks."
"It's not like Luoye Peak. Although the courtyard has a nice view, it always feels deserted when you live there."
"If you like it, you can come and stay anytime." Shen Suan said casually.
"Then I take it seriously." Shen Xue's eyes lit up and her eyebrows curled up in a smile.
Just as he was talking, Shen Yi suddenly shouted from the backyard: "I'm hooked! I'm hooked! It's so big!"
Then came Zhong Yuan's voice: "Don't pull, don't pull! The thread is about to break!"
Then Huzi exclaimed: "Wow - what a big fish!"
Immediately afterwards there was a burst of crackling water, mixed with several people shouting hurriedly.
The autumn breeze is refreshing, and the rice waves are heavy.
Shen Suan and the other three rode flaming horses and wandered aimlessly along the river.
The river is winding like a belt, with patches of green rice on both sides. The ears of rice hang low, dancing gently in the wind, setting off layers of green waves, full of life.
The sun shines on the rice leaves, glowing with fine golden light, and the air is filled with the fragrance of rice flowers, mixed with the smell of earth, which is refreshing.
Shen Suan tightened the reins and slowed down, his eyes falling on the heavy ears of rice.
After being in this world for so long, this was the first time he saw rice fields.
The rice fields in my hometown in my previous life were like this. They stretched as far as the eye could see, and the wind blew the rice waves, which was so beautiful.
"Master, this is the rice with spiritual power." Xiao Liu pointed at the patches of rice and introduced it, with a bit of pride in his tone. "It is a new variety that has been cultivated in recent years. It is very fragrant and delicious, and contains a hint of spiritual power. Eating it can nourish the qi and blood. It is a good thing!"
"It took the main tribe hundreds of years to successfully cultivate it, and it has only been in the past few years that it has begun to promote cultivation."
